gloss: to write, to publish, to author

definitions.explanation: To write and publish a book or work.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{多|おお}くの{論文|ろんぶん}を{著|あらわ}した。
{若|わか}くして{名著|めいちょ}を{著|あらわ}した。
examples.english: He authored a masterpiece at a young age.

examples.japanese: その{学者|がくしゃ}は{歴史|れきし}に{関|かん}する{本|ほん}を{何冊|なんさつ}も{著|あらわ}している。
examples.english: That scholar has authored many books on history.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{自分|じぶん}の{経験|けいけん}をもとに{一冊|いっさつ}の{本|ほん}を{著|あらわ}し、{多|おお}くの{人|ひと}に{読|よ}まれた。
examples.english: She authored a book based on her own experience, and it was read by many people.

notes:
{著|あらわ}す is a formal verb meaning to write and publish a book or scholarly work.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- Pattern: [work]を{著|あらわ}す

HOMOPHONE DISTINCTIONS:
Three verbs read 'あらわす' with different meanings:
- {著|あらわ}す: to author, publish (books/papers)
- {表|あらわ}す: to express, represent
- {現|あらわ}す: to reveal, make appear

REGISTER:
This is formal/literary language. In everyday conversation, {本|ほん}を{書|か}く (to write a book) is more common.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {本|ほん}を{著|あらわ}す: to publish a book
- {論文|ろんぶん}を{著|あらわ}す: to author a paper
- {著書|ちょしょ}: authored work, one's publications
- {著者|ちょしゃ}: author
